headline_marked: [[Apple to increase spend with Broadcom]] to produce billions more U.S. chips
headline: Apple to increase spend with Broadcom to produce billions more U.S. chips
summary: Apple commits over $30 billion in a new multiyear agreement with Broadcom for custom silicon and wireless tech. This expands US manufacturing, supporting hundreds of American jobs and producing billions of chips.
details: Apple has announced a new multiyear commitment with Broadcom, expected to exceed $30 billion. This agreement is for the design and production of custom silicon components and cutting-edge wireless connectivity technologies for Apple products.
The deal will lead to the production of over 15 billion U.S.-made chips and support hundreds of American jobs. It advances Apple's efforts to create an end-to-end silicon supply chain in America.

This new agreement is Apple's largest commitment to date under its American Manufacturing Program (AMP). It will enable Broadcom to expand and modernize its manufacturing facilities in Fort Collins, Colorado, with a $1.5 billion capital expenditure investment.

The Fort Collins facility will specifically produce advanced radio frequency components, including FBAR filters, and advanced wireless connectivity technologies. Both Apple CEO Tim Cook and Broadcom CEO Hock Tan expressed pride in the partnership.

These investments are part of Apple’s broader commitment to invest $600 billion in the U.S. economy over four years. This initiative aims to support manufacturing, job creation, and technology development across the country.

headline_marked: [[DuckDuckGo Browser can now block video ads]], including YouTube's
headline: DuckDuckGo Browser can now block video ads, including YouTube's
summary: The feature is on by default for most users on iPhone, Windows, and Mac, with Android coming soon. It relies on open-source filter lists but may cause longer buffering.
details: DuckDuckGo announced that its browser can now block most video ads, specifically on YouTube. This new feature is based on open-source community filter lists from uBlockOrigin.
While DuckDuckGo may apply its own rules for better compatibility, users might experience longer buffering times. Some unexpected hiccups could also occur.
The ad-blocking feature is enabled by default for iPhone, Windows, and Mac users. Android users will get it automatically soon, but can manually activate it now in settings.
Users can toggle YouTube ad blocking on or off in the browser settings across all platforms. To benefit from the blocker, videos must be watched within the DuckDuckGo browser, not the YouTube app.
caption:
DuckDuckGo's browser now blocks video ads on YouTube and other platforms. Watch videos without interruptions, with the feature on by default for most users.

DuckDuckGo announced that its browser can now block most video ads, specifically on YouTube. This new feature is based on open-source community filter lists from uBlockOrigin.

While DuckDuckGo may apply its own rules for better compatibility, users might experience longer buffering times. Some unexpected hiccups could also occur.

The ad-blocking feature is enabled by default for iPhone, Windows, and Mac users. Android users will get it automatically soon, but can manually activate it now in settings.

Users can toggle YouTube ad blocking on or off in the browser settings across all platforms. To benefit from the blocker, videos must be watched within the DuckDuckGo browser, not the YouTube app.
